name: Omarchy Help
author: modpunk
description: Offline help for Omarchy, in a window that stays open. Type to search your live keybindings, the omarchy CLI, and the manual for your installed version; results appear as you type with no network and no model. Run a command straight from the results in a floating terminal, open the manual at the matching section, or chat with the local GPU model about what to do.

barWidget.description: Bar button that opens Omarchy Help: search keybindings, commands and the manual; run, open, or chat.
